resources.string: Import ZIP as a new workspace
Accepts earlier workspace exports. Creates a separate local workspace; never overwrites existing files, chats or settings.

Exports /workspace files only. Skips caches, build outputs, task logs and symbolic links. Does not include Linux or executable permissions. The archive may contain private files; do not share it publicly.

Keep this page open until the transfer finishes. Imported files do not include Linux; install it in the new workspace before running commands. Old ZIP exports do not preserve symbolic links or executable permissions.
No local workspace available to export.
A new local workspace will be created. Leave the archive layout unchanged unless all files are inside the selected outer directory.

Turn off to include all regular files, including .git, build, cache and tmp directories. Task logs (.jobs), symbolic links and special files are always excluded.
